title: Distributed grouped multi-aggregate fan-out (COUNT/SUM/MIN/MAX)
shape: SELECT g[, ...], AGG1, AGG2[, ...] GROUP BY g; each AGG in COUNT(*)/COUNT(col)/SUM/MIN/MAX (>=2 or multi/mixed); AVG and DISTINCT excluded -> 449

design.merge: COUNT(*)/COUNT(col)/SUM add partials (kind Sum); MIN/MAX extremum; each aggregate merges independently into its own per-group accumulator
design.per_owner_sql: owners run the ORIGINAL query (all directly mergeable, no rewrite); stripped when HAVING/ORDER/LIMIT present
design.dispatch: after the single-aggregate planners at all 4 entry points; reuses post-merge (HAVING/ORDER/LIMIT)
